description: Windfury Totem 250 Mana Instant Requires Shaman Requires level 52 Tools: Air Totem Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with (246 * 1 ) extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.
name: Windfury Totem
